title: Code Word Chart
subtitle: Complete reference for NATO letter code words and digit codes
aboutText: This chart lists the 26 letters A to Z with their ICAO code words and the 10 digit codes. Letters such as B and D or M and N are easy to confuse by voice, so each one has a fixed word.
howToUse1: Click the tabs above to switch between letters and codes
howToUse2: Each cell shows the letter or digit and its code word
howToUse3: Use this as a quick reference while drilling
howToUse4: Press Ctrl+P (or Command+P on Mac) to print or save as PDF for offline use
practiceText: Head to a training mode to practice these code words. Try Pick Mode for recognition, Input Mode for recall, or Blitz Mode for speed.
